HomePage.title: A Professional Trading Platform With Built-in AI Intelligence.
HomePage.description: Experience zero-lag charts with real-time MT5 data. Generate strategies, leverage AI trade monitoring, evaluate your trades, and build your rules on a platform strictly superior to TradingView.

chart.title: Smart Chart & Analysis
chart.desc: Experience sub-second candle rendering with smart analysis tools. Optimized for precision scalping and fast execution.

diamond.title: Diamond Chart
diamond.desc: Our exclusive Diamond rendering gives you unique insights into market structures that regular candles hide.

strategy.title: Strategy Builder
strategy.desc: Create, test, and live-follow custom strategies. Turn your ideas into an automated AI system.

matrix.title: Smart Signal Matrix
matrix.desc: Never miss a trade. Monitor dozens of pairs simultaneously based on your custom rules. Get instant alerts.

aiMonitor.title: AI Trade Monitor
aiMonitor.desc: Advanced AI tracking, trade evaluation, and confidence scoring. Let AI assess the market and your positions in real time.

mt5Data.title: Exclusive Broker Data
mt5Data.desc: Direct tick data feeds from MT5. Trade with the exact prices you execute on, a critical edge over TradingView.

indicators.title: Unlimited Tools
indicators.desc: No arbitrary limits. Apply unlimited indicators, set unlimited alerts, and build as complex a template as you need.

multiChart.title: Multi-Chart Workspaces
multiChart.desc: View multiple charts on a single screen, or span multiple screens with our advanced multi-window synchronization.

step1.title: Analyze & Build
step1.desc: Use high-fidelity MT5 data and Diamond charts to find opportunities and define your rules.

step2.title: AI Monitor & Alert
step2.desc: Let the AI monitor your rules, evaluate trades, and score market confidence.

step3.title: Execute & Backtest
step3.desc: Place trades, backtest strategies, and review AI trade evaluations directly on the chart.

Mt5Activation.title: Activate MT5 Connection
Mt5Activation.subtitle: Confirm the consent items below to finish MT5 onboarding on this machine.

checklist.title: MT5 readiness
checklist.subtitle: Buy the module first, then finish native bridge onboarding and consent before unlocking the terminal.
checklist.bridgeState: Bridge status is read directly from the live terminal store.
checklist.accountReady: The current store already contains account data.
checklist.accountPending: The terminal unlocks after account data is synced.
checklist.consentReady: You can return to the chart and continue working.
checklist.consentPending: Check both consent boxes before saving.
checklist.footer: This checklist reflects the live terminal state. It does not claim the account is ready when the store has no data.

page.note: You are confirming MT5 consent on this machine. The flow stores local consent and unlocks the terminal only when the bridge and account state are valid.
page.ready: Ready to save consent and go back to the chart.
page.heroTitle: Complete consent, then return to chart
page.heroDescription: This screen stores local consent, keeps onboarding visible, and unlocks the terminal only when bridge and account data are ready.

terms.riskWarning: I have read and accepted the capital risk when syncing MT5 with the system. All trading decisions remain my responsibility.
terms.accountSync: I agree to link my internal MT5 account number with my Vivutrade account for valid trade tracking.

gating.purchaseTitle: This account has not purchased the Your MT5 module
gating.purchaseBody: Buy the module on the pricing page first. After purchase, return to the guide to install the bridge and continue activation.
gating.activationBlocked: This activation step is available only after the current account has purchased the Your MT5 module.

native.waitingLoginTitle: Desktop app is waiting for login
native.waitingLoginBody: Sign in to Vivutrade inside the desktop app so it can obtain an access token and start the local bridge.
native.startingBody: The desktop app is launching the native bridge. Keep MT5 open on this machine and wait a moment for the connection.
native.errorBody: The desktop app reported a bridge error. Open logs or restart the bridge before trying the activation flow again.
native.waitingMt5Title: Bridge is running, waiting for MT5
native.waitingMt5Body: The bridge is online but MT5 data has not arrived yet. Open MT5 on this machine and keep it signed in.
native.waitingAccountBody: The bridge is online, but the terminal has not received account identity yet. Wait for MT5 to finish syncing.
native.activeBody: The local bridge is running and the account can continue with the MT5 consent flow.

Mt5Activation.successMessage: MT5 consent saved. Returning to chart...
